extraction_notes: Main-text catalytic-performance figures digitised: Figure 6 and Figure 7. Equilibrium series in Figures 6c and 7c were skipped because they are calculated/theoretical, not measured catalytic performance. Figures 1-5 are reactor schematic or characterization and were not extracted. The plotted CH3OH yield values are recorded in notes because the target schema has no methanol-yield field; methanol_sty is left null.
